dataset_description: A dataset of steel-industry electricity-use observations recorded at 15-minute intervals over a calendar year. Each row describes one interval using active electrical energy consumption, lagging and leading reactive energy, corresponding power-factor measurements, estimated carbon-dioxide emissions, time within the day, weekday context, and an operational load category. The dataset supports regression of industrial electricity consumption and tabular synthetic-data experiments that should preserve meaningful relationships among electrical, temporal, and operating variables.

column_descriptions.Lagging_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh: Lagging reactive electrical energy during the observation interval, measured in kilovolt-ampere reactive hours (kVArh). It represents the inductive reactive component associated with current that lags voltage.
column_descriptions.Leading_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh: Leading reactive electrical energy during the observation interval, measured in kilovolt-ampere reactive hours (kVArh). It represents the capacitive reactive component associated with current that leads voltage.
column_descriptions.CO2(tCO2): Estimated carbon-dioxide emissions associated with the interval's electricity use, measured in metric tonnes of CO2.
column_descriptions.Lagging_Current_Power_Factor: Power-factor measurement associated with lagging current, expressed on a percentage scale from 0 to 100. Higher values indicate that a greater share of apparent electrical power is active power.
column_descriptions.Leading_Current_Power_Factor: Power-factor measurement associated with leading current, expressed on a percentage scale from 0 to 100. Higher values indicate that a greater share of apparent electrical power is active power.
column_descriptions.NSM: Number of seconds elapsed since local midnight at the observation time. Values lie on a daily clock from 0 for 00:00:00 through 86399 immediately before the next midnight; the observations occur at 15-minute intervals.
column_descriptions.WeekStatus: Whether the observation falls on a weekday or weekend.
column_descriptions.Day_of_week: Name of the local calendar day on which the observation was recorded, from Monday through Sunday.
column_descriptions.Load_Type: Categorical operating-load level assigned to the interval, with values representing light, medium, or maximum load.
column_descriptions.Usage_kWh: Active electrical energy consumed by the steel facility during the observation interval, measured in kilowatt-hours (kWh). This is the regression target.
